name: vlm_microtubule_bundling_severity
description: Provides a visual score for the severity of microtubule bundling (thick, rigid fibers). This phenotype is characteristic of taxane treatment and involves distinguishing between fine meshworks and coarse, hyper-intense cables.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells, focusing on the Tubulin channel.
method_rationale: Distinguishing 'bundling' from simply 'bright' microtubules involves perceiving the thickness and rigidity of fibers, a semantic visual task well-suited for VLMs.
